notes.title: Achievements were patched.
notes.content: Fixed unexpected behaviours in some achievements.

notes.title: HARSH. NOW SUPPORTS GAMEPADS.
notes.content:
Hey there, folks.

Just dropped a very anticipated update: gamepad compatibility is officially in the mix! Now you can dive into the chaos with your trusty gamepad in hand :D

Got more ideas or requests? Shoot 'em my way! I'm all ears, even if I can't magic up your dream feature overnight, I'll give it a shot. Let's keep making HARSH. even more badass together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900685/9c7af0189193a6529514da141e4b4267079a0ef2.png[/img]
Opia Pirc.
